courses.name: B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering
courses.summary: A four-year undergraduate engineering degree covering structural analysis and design, geotechnical engineering, transportation engineering, water resources, environmental engineering, surveying and construction management. Programmes pair lecture teaching with materials, hydraulics and surveying laboratories, site visits and a final-year design project. Graduates work in construction, infrastructure, consultancy and public works, or continue to a master's specialisation.

courses.name: B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering
courses.summary: A four-year undergraduate engineering degree covering engineering mechanics, thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, heat transfer, machine design, manufacturing processes and control systems. Teaching is built around workshop practice, thermal and materials laboratories, computer-aided design and a final-year project. Graduates move into manufacturing, automotive, energy, thermal and design roles, or continue to a master's specialisation such as thermal engineering or machine design.

universities.summary: M.I.E.T. Engineering College (MIET) is a private, self-financing engineering college founded in 1998 on the Trichy-Pudukkottai Road at Gundur, Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu. It is not a university: it is an autonomous college affiliated to Anna University, Chennai, which awards its degrees. It teaches eight AICTE-approved B.E./B.Tech branches and an MBA in English.
universities.campusLifestyle: M.I.E.T. Engineering College (MIET)'s campus on the Trichy-Pudukkottai Road has A, B and C academic blocks, separate hostels for men and women, playgrounds, a gym and a mini theatre. Its library in C Block covers 725 sq m with 50,442 volumes in 18,329 titles, open 9 am to 7 pm on working days, with IEEE, Springer, Elsevier, ASME and ASCE e-journals and DELNET and National Digital Library membership. The site also lists NSS, NCC, clubs, a masjid and a bank on campus.
universities.cityProfile: M.I.E.T. Engineering College (MIET) is at Gundur on the Trichy-Pudukkottai Road, Tiruchirappalli 620007, in Tiruverumbur taluk of Tiruchirappalli district, Tamil Nadu, near Tiruchirappalli airport. TNEA 2026 lists it 8 km from both the district headquarters and Tiruchirappalli railway station. Anna University lists it among the Tiruchirappalli district colleges with examination code 8124. The college is run by the Mohamed Institute of Education and Technology (MIET) Society, founded in 1984, which also runs M.I.E.T. Arts and Science College and M.I.E.T. Polytechnic College; those institutions are not covered here.
universities.practicalExposure: M.I.E.T. Engineering College (MIET) has been an autonomous college since 2024-25: UGC and Anna University granted autonomy for 2024-25 to 2033-34, so MIET writes its own Regulations 2024 curricula and conducts its own examinations, while Anna University approves and awards the degree. Theory courses carry 40 marks of continuous assessment and a 60-mark end-semester examination. AICTE makes an internship mandatory for every admitted student, and the 2026-27 calendar schedules industrial visits, guest lectures and value-added courses for each department. The training and placement cell runs aptitude, English and technical training, group discussions and mock interviews; the college reported a 93 per cent placement rate in its TNEA 2026 entry without stating the year or base.
universities.hostelOverview: M.I.E.T. Engineering College (MIET) has permanent on-campus hostels for men and women, according to TNEA 2026. The 2026 TNEA college booklet lists room rent at INR 21,000 a year, electricity at INR 12,000 a year and mess at INR 40,000 a year, with no caution deposit. The college hostel page lists RO drinking water, a gym, indoor games, a reading room, a computer lab with internet and a mini theatre.
universities.dietarySupport: M.I.E.T. Engineering College (MIET)'s hostel messes serve both vegetarian and non-vegetarian food, according to the TNEA 2026 college booklet and the college's hostel page. The mess charge is INR 40,000 a year. No menu or provision for specific regional or religious diets is published, so ask the hostel office before joining.
universities.safetyOverview: M.I.E.T. Engineering College (MIET) states that ragging is prohibited on campus and has an anti-ragging committee chaired by the principal, plus an internal committee. The hostel page lists 24-hour ambulance service for emergencies. TNEA 2026 publishes a separate anti-ragging helpline number for the college.
universities.studentSupport: M.I.E.T. Engineering College (MIET) handles complaints through a student grievance redressal committee chaired by the vice principal, and students can also file grievances on the college's online portal. The training and placement cell offers coaching for government exams and for TOEFL, IELTS, GRE and GMAT, and the site lists a merit scholarship.
whyChoose: M.I.E.T. Engineering College (MIET) is an autonomous college accredited by NAAC with an A+ grade (CGPA 3.33, valid to 14 February 2027), and Anna University awards its degrees.
Eight B.E./B.Tech branches were offered in TNEA 2026 under college code 3811, with intakes from 30 (Civil, Biomedical) to 180 (Computer Science and Engineering), plus a 60-seat MBA.
TNEA 2026 publishes the college's hostel costs: room rent INR 21,000, electricity INR 12,000 and mess INR 40,000 a year, with separate permanent hostels for men and women.
thingsToConsider: M.I.E.T. Engineering College (MIET) publishes no tuition amount; its fee page says fees follow Government of Tamil Nadu norms, so confirm the current tuition with the college before choosing a quota.
There is no route for international students: AICTE's 2025-26 approval shows no NRI or foreign-national seats, and TNEA admits only Indian nationals and Tamil Nadu-native OCI/PIO card holders.

Only B.E. Civil Engineering holds current NBA accreditation (to 30 June 2027); ECE's ran to 30 June 2026, and CSE, EEE and Mechanical's lapsed in June 2025. The college's M.E. programmes are not listed here because no 2026-27 intake evidence was found.

faq.question: Is MIET Engineering College Trichy autonomous?
faq.answer: Yes, M.I.E.T. Engineering College (MIET) is autonomous: UGC conferred autonomous status for 10 years, 2024-25 to 2033-34, and Anna University issued its order in February 2024. MIET sets its own curricula and examinations under Regulations 2024, but it remains affiliated to Anna University, Chennai, which awards the degree.

faq.question: What is the TNEA code of MIET Engineering College?
faq.answer: The TNEA counselling code for M.I.E.T. Engineering College (MIET) is 3811, and its Anna University examination code is 8124. In TNEA 2026 it offered Civil (CE), Mechanical (ME), EEE (EE), ECE (EC), CSE (CS), Biomedical (BM), IT and AI and Data Science (AD) seats.

faq.question: Is MIET Trichy AICTE approved and NAAC accredited?
faq.answer: Yes, M.I.E.T. Engineering College (MIET) is AICTE approved (permanent ID 1-7532291, private self-financing) and NAAC accredited with an A+ grade and a CGPA of 3.33 in its first cycle, valid to 14 February 2027. NBA accredits its B.E. Civil Engineering programme to 30 June 2027.

faq.question: What is the fee at MIET Engineering College?
faq.answer: M.I.E.T. Engineering College (MIET) does not publish its tuition; its fee page says fees are as prescribed by the Government of Tamil Nadu, so ask the college for the current amount. TNEA 2026 lists an admission fee of INR 5,000, hostel room rent of INR 21,000, electricity of INR 12,000 and mess of INR 40,000 a year, and transport of INR 6,200 to 25,400 a year.

faq.question: Does MIET Engineering College have hostels?
faq.answer: Yes, M.I.E.T. Engineering College (MIET) has separate permanent on-campus hostels for men and women, with messes serving vegetarian and non-vegetarian food. TNEA 2026 lists room rent at INR 21,000, electricity at INR 12,000 and mess at INR 40,000 a year, with no caution deposit.

faq.question: Can NRI or international students apply to MIET Trichy?
faq.answer: No, M.I.E.T. Engineering College (MIET) has no NRI or foreign-national seats: AICTE's 2025-26 approval marks NRI and foreign/OCI approval as No for every programme. TNEA is for Indian nationals; OCI/PIO card holders who are natives of Tamil Nadu may join unless born abroad after 4 March 2021.

faq.question: How do I get admission to MIET Engineering College?
faq.answer: Most B.E./B.Tech seats at M.I.E.T. Engineering College (MIET) are filled through TNEA: register at tneaonline.org, get a rank from Mathematics (100), Physics (50) and Chemistry (50), and choose code 3811. TNEA 2026 counselling ran 20 July to 30 August, and MIET started first-year classes on 24 August 2026. MBA seats use TANCET and state MBA counselling.

faq.question: Who awards the degree at MIET Engineering College?
faq.answer: Anna University, Chennai awards the degrees of M.I.E.T. Engineering College (MIET). MIET is an affiliated college, not a university; as an autonomous college it designs its syllabus and runs its examinations, and Anna University approves the results and issues the B.E., B.Tech and MBA degrees.

faq.question: Is MIET Trichy the same as Mahath Amma Institute of Engineering and Technology (MIET), Pudukkottai?
faq.answer: No, M.I.E.T. Engineering College (MIET) at Gundur, Tiruchirappalli (TNEA code 3811) is a different college from Mahath Amma Institute of Engineering and Technology, which also uses the short form MIET and is at Illupur, Pudukkottai district (TNEA code 3854). Check the TNEA code when filling choices.
